reason: An agent integration plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness sessions to Onlyne for receiving and sending messages across Telegram, Feishu/Lark, QQ Bot, and WeChat.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话连接到 Onlyne，以接收并发送 Telegram、飞书、QQ Bot 和微信消息。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness sessions to Onlyne for receiving and sending messages through Telegram, Feishu/Lark, QQ Bot, and WeChat.

capabilities: Receives inbound messages from Telegram, Feishu/Lark, QQ Bot, and WeChat channels
Sends replies and broadcasts messages to configured IM channels
Starts, stops, and restarts the Onlyne messaging daemon
Injects local loopback wake-up messages into a running session
